The rank of an elliptic curve is hard to compute. It corresponds to the number of independent points of infinite order. R=0 means all rational points are torsion (finite group). R=1 means there's one direction of infinite rational solutions. R>1 means the curve has more complicated arithmetic. Think of Z^r as a lattice in r-dimensional space. The higher the rank, the more "spread out" the rational solutions are. Rank is not defined over a finite field.
